epics.title: Card file ingestion
epics.description: Pick up, parse, validate and load the daily Meridian file before 6 a.m. Eastern, with a configurable layout and duplicate protection. Excludes matching.

epics.title: Card data security and audit
epics.description: Meet PCI obligations for card data and record every automatic action. Covers masking, raw file handling and audit trail.

epics.title: Transaction-to-trip matching
epics.description: Match each card transaction to the right SkyLane trip and record the billed amount. Excludes what happens after the match.

epics.title: Expense lines and unassigned queue
epics.description: Turn matched transactions into expense lines and give travellers a queue and reminders for the rest.

epics.title: Operations visibility
epics.description: Show finance admins the daily health of the feed so they hear about problems before travellers do.
